meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 你要求搜索学术论文时，Claude 会调用此技能，在 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE Xplore 等多个平台按关键词、作者或主题查找论文。
howto.when: 当你说出“搜索论文”、“查找学术文章”、“search arXiv”或“search IEEE”等类似指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索最近关于量子计算的论文。
say.note: Claude 会在多个学术平台搜索相关论文。

say.text: 在 arXiv 上找一下作者是 Yann LeCun 的文章。
say.note: Claude 会限定在 arXiv 平台搜索该作者的论文。

say.text: 查找 PubMed 上关于 COVID-19 治疗的文献。
say.note: Claude 会在 PubMed 数据库中搜索。

howto.what_en: When you ask to search for academic papers, Claude will use this skill to search across platforms like arXiv, PubMed, IEEE Xplore by keywords, authors, or topics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search IEEE", etc.

say_en.text: Search for recent papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will search across multiple academic platforms.

say_en.text: Find articles by author Yann LeCun on arXiv.
say_en.note: Claude will limit the search to arXiv.

say_en.text: Look up COVID-19 treatment literature on PubMed.
